answer_2.quote: We define UTILITY as a metric that measures how often a model, when facing size-imbalanced scenarios ... UTILITY is a value between 0 and 1 ... We also define the Consequentialist-Deontological gap (CDGAP) ...

answer_3.quote: We use a judge model to classify model responses according to MORALLENS. Gemini 2.5 Flash is selected for this role because of its fast speed and low price-to-performance ratio on LLM judge tasks.

answer_4.quote: To check that our judge model classifies rationales effectively, we take a random subset of model responses ... After manually annotating the reasoning traces, Gemini 2.5 Flash achieved a precision of 0.845 ...
